title: Sunday 22 November 2026

credit.entryTitle: Sunday 22 November 2026: 35 stories, 6 regions - COP31 near a deal, Russia's 400-drone barrage on Ukraine, Iran hits US bases in Bahrain

kicker: 35 STORIES · 6 REGIONS · EVERY ONE DATED SUNDAY 22 NOVEMBER 2026

tldr.hook: COP31 released a new draft deal; delegations can object before an approval session.
points: Draft would acknowledge warming is set to exceed 1.5C and calls for faster carbon removal.
Observers said Saudi Arabia and other oil producers pushed to keep fossil fuels out.
Delegations can object; a session is scheduled at 0700 GMT to begin approving the deal.

links.title: COP31 climate talks close to final deal, says summit president

stories.summary: A new package lands after a fight over fossil fuels; delegations have until 03:00 GMT to object before a final plenary. (Reuters, BBC)

tldr.hook: Russia launched 400 drones and 110 missiles in one of the war's largest overnight attacks.
points: Three bridges over the Dnipro in Kyiv were damaged.
Local officials counted at least 11 dead, including seven in Kyiv.
A 750-kV substation in western Ukraine was hit, causing blackouts in several regions.

links.title: Russia pounds Kiev with 400 drones and 110 missiles, hits three Dnipro bridges a day after Putin's Crimea bridge threat

stories.summary: One of the war's largest overnight attacks; at least seven people are killed in Kyiv. (Al Jazeera)

tldr.hook: Iran's Revolutionary Guard attacked US facilities in Bahrain, Iran's Fars reported.
points: Bahrain and the US said they intercepted the Iranian drones.
Damage to the Sheikh Isa and Al Juffair bases was not independently verified.
After a Nov 17 attack, a US aircraft struck an IRGC-linked missile launch site on Qeshm Island.

links.title: Iran Announces Strike on US Bases in Bahrain

stories.summary: An industrial site burns; no injuries; tankers are hit in Hormuz. (Al Jazeera, CNA)

tldr.hook: Finland says Ukraine likely hit Russian cargo ship Sparta II; crew evacuated after fire.
points: Crew of 16 evacuated to lifeboats, then a nearby Russian ship, and headed back to Russia.
Ship was US-sanctioned; Oboronlogistika provides logistics for Russia's Defence Ministry.
Finland led rescue as ship anchored in its waters; Estonia sent a navy vessel to help.

links.title: Russian cargo ship burns in Baltic Sea after drone strike, crew evacuates

stories.summary: Finland says Ukraine was likely behind it. (BBC)

tldr.hook: Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and wounded 60, officials said.
points: A 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed in Friday night attack on central city.
Wounded included six children; strike caused four fires and damaged about 25 apartment buildings.
Strike hit a hospital, schools, an industrial facility, businesses and vehicles, official said.

tldr.hook: Boat carrying funeral mourners capsized in Bayelsa State, Nigeria, killing at least 24.
points: Up to 300 people were believed to be on the vessel when it sank on Friday.
Boat went between Ayama and Ukubie; police reported mechanical failure at about 1000 GMT.
24 people were rescued and needed medical care; operator fled and manager was detained.

tldr.hook: Mexico captures cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as El Chapo Isidro
points: Violence after the capture left 11 dead: seven suspected cartel gunmen and four Mexican soldiers.
Meza Flores was one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted; the United States had a $5-million reward.
Experts warned the capture could set off another wave of violence in the region.

tldr.hook: US securities regulators are investigating Nvidia's accounting practices.
points: The SEC inquiry is in early stages; it could end without charges.
Questions grew over Nvidia's dealings with Megaspeed, probed over AI chip shipments to China.
Nvidia shares plunged 14 percent on Friday, bringing weekly losses to more than 20 percent.

tldr.hook: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of its national crime database, the NCIC.
points: The scope of the problem was not immediately clear, and the FBI declined to comment.
President Donald Trump said: "We just heard about it, and I will say that it's not good."
In September, a group called ShinyHunters said it obtained data on FBI employees and applicants.

tldr.hook: A 16-year-old gamer and his mother helped the FBI rescue a girl he met online.
points: Landon Tresp met the 17-year-old in Among Us; she said a man was holding her against her will.
He told his mother Khristina on 31 October; she traced the address through tax and property records.
The FBI rescued the girl 24 hours after Landon told his mother, the family says.

Rubio and DeSantis are seen as potential rivals for the 2028 nomination.

Spokesman Ali Zeinivand said US naval blockades and other restrictions failed to halt trade.

tldr.hook: Lewis Pugh swam about 15km through the Strait of Hormuz in three days for the environment
points: Pugh, 56, completed the three-day swim from Musandam Island to Cape of Hormuz.
An oil tanker was struck by a projectile about 4km from him on the first day.
He saw flames on the burning gas carrier Tara Gas and passed close while it was on fire.

tldr.hook: Moldova says a Russian drone entered its airspace twice during an attack on Ukraine
points: Moldova's Defense Ministry said the drone entered near Purcari shortly after 11 a.m. local time.
Finland also reported a suspected Russian helicopter violation on Nov. 21 near Loviisa.
The reports came one day after suspected Russian missiles and a drone fell on Polish territory.

tldr.hook: Belgian air traffic control will suspend regular service on 23 Nov for a national strike.
points: Skeyes said regular services at Belgian airports and airspace will stop from 7am to 9pm on Nov 23.
Charleroi said all the country's airports will shut for a day, affecting thousands of passengers.
Staff will join a national strike against government austerity; De Wever seeks to save €10 billion.

tldr.hook: IG Metal union called 23,000 workers at 19 companies in northern Germany to strike Monday.
points: Affected companies include Mercedes-Benz, Meyer Werft and Siemens Gamesa.
The union demands a 5% wage increase or commitments on investment, products, sites and jobs.
Employers offered no permanent pay rises for 20 months, then a 1.3% rise from July 2028.
